title: ep1.0_research_preview.md
variant: stick-figure dialogue reel v2 · the recorded takes over a temp bed
logline: Act One for flow and dialogue: fastrec takes laid to the script's shot directions, one beat per shot or held setup. Stick figures and text cards stand in for the picture.

beats.frame: INSERT · the beige button
beats.caption: A small beige button where the 1993 OK sat. Its 7 px label: research preview.
cues: cut: HARD CUT on the downbeat, out of the card
sound: the bullpen bed (server hum up through the floor, one buzzing tube, Gerg's keys) · music: none under the talk

beats.frame: WIDE · the bullpen after hours (the home room's one wide)
beats.caption: Gerg's green laptop, Rima's LOW-KEY underlined twice, Alyi in the glass. A cursor parks on the button.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Gerg, desk to desk (held)
beats.caption: Gerg ships before anyone agrees. Rima, from the whiteboard, not turning round. Gerg: nobody reads research.

lines.text: Okay, the build's green. I'm shipping it.
We said low-key, Gerg. I underlined it. Twice.
It's a research preview, Rima. Nobody reads research. We'll get forty users and a nice thread.

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto Rima (held through the bargain)
beats.caption: Rima bargains (one post, a banner), Gerg waves it off; she asks Mas what it costs. "it's a preview."

lines.text: Then let's treat it like one. No press, no keynote. One post, and a banner that says it can be wrong.
It'll have a banner. Nobody reads banners either.
Mas, it's your call. If it breaks in front of people, and it will, what do we tell them?
And if it works? If people actually use it, it's going to cost us a fortune.

beats.frame: MCU·glass · Alyi's reflection (the cut on the turn)
beats.caption: A new voice from the glass turns cost into dread, picking up her "And if".

beats.frame: MCU · Rima turns to Mas and waits (1 beat, hers)
beats.caption: She turns from the glass to Mas and waits. His answer lands on her face.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Gerg (Rima back at the board)
beats.caption: One key, a flourish: "Your button." Behind him Rima underlines LOW-KEY a third time. No line.

lines.text: It's all staged on my end. Your button.

cues: sfx: one key, with a flourish · then the marker squeaks: a third underline

beats.frame: INSERT · his finger on the button
beats.caption: His finger, no hover. Click. Nothing happens. The date lands on the click.
cues: sfx: click (on 1.0 s) · nothing happens · the band dims back into cutscene mode
beats.real: NOV 30, 2022 · CHATGTP launches as a "research preview": one post, no keynote [facts #3]

beats.frame: MCU·glass · Mas soft in the fg; Rima at the board; Alyi in the glass
beats.caption: Alyi, low, to Mas only: the years they share, to the click. "you counted." "Someone should."

lines.text: Six years and eleven months. From the day we started to that click.

cues: sound: Gerg's keys under the shot; Rima, at the board, doesn't hear it

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto his laptop (the chat's one setup)
beats.caption: "Autocomplete." The bubble lights before anyone types, and flatters. He types one line. It flatters him.

lines.text: Autocomplete that read the internet, Rima. All of it.

beats.frame: MCU · Mas, lit from below (his one close shot here)
beats.caption: "it likes me." Gerg, off, not looking: it likes everyone.

lines.text: It likes everyone. It called my variable names inspired.

beats.frame: INSERT · the bubble: the counter ticks
beats.caption: A second user arrives. Then a hundred. The 0 ticks over, and the digits blur.
cues: music: MM-16 Odometer (temp pad) comes in on the counter's first tick (0.5 s)

beats.frame: ECU → WIDE · the counter grows (phrase 1, bars 1-2)
beats.caption: The counter detaches and grows into a desk-sized odometer, spinning. V.O. on bar 2.

seq.place: the odometer drill: down through the building

cues: music: MM-16, one performance, 14 bars (4·3·4·3) · thins to bass + brushes under the posts, ducks under the V.O.
sfx: odometer_ratchet, chip notes on F, varied rhythm and pitch (never even beeps)
style (proposed, drastic tier): the descent as a low-poly 3D cutaway of the building · default BASE

beats.frame: WIDE · the drop through the desk (bars 3-4)
beats.caption: On the downbeat it drops through the desk with a clunk. The picture shows the size.
cues: sfx: a whole-pixel CLUNK on the downbeat (0.0 s)

beats.frame: WIDE · vertical scroll into the kitchen (phrase 2, bar 1)
beats.caption: A whole-pixel scroll down into the kitchen. Staffers duck as it bores through the ceiling.

beats.frame: INSERT · cut up: Gerg's desk, his phone (bars 2-3)
beats.caption: A post pops on Gerg's phone. He hearts it; the plate lands after the read. Rima's hand un-hearts it.

onscreen.text: POST: NOLE: “CHATGTP is scary good. We are not far from dangerously strong AI.”

cues: music: MM-16 thins to bass + brushes under the post
beats.real: DEC 3, 2022 · NOLE: "CHATGTP is scary good…" [V] · the plate is invented (facts §D)

beats.frame: WIDE · down the shaft to bedrock (phrase 3)
beats.caption: Back down the shaft to the basement. The odometer punches into bedrock and stops, wedged.

beats.frame: INSERT · the last wheel
beats.caption: Its last wheel clicks over and settles, legible for the first time: 1,000,000.

beats.frame: INSERT · cut up: Gerg's thumbs, a post composer
beats.caption: The same angle on Gerg's desk: his thumbs post the number.

onscreen.text: POST: GERG: “CHATGTP just crossed 1 million users; it's been 5 days since launch”

cues: on screen only: the post is not voiced (script: posts are pop-ups, never speeches)
beats.real: DEC 5, 2022 · GERG: 1 million users, 5 days since launch [V]

beats.frame: HIGH · the hole in the floor, Rima peering down
beats.caption: Rima hands back her launch-night word. Gerg, off: very low.

beats.frame: HIGH (held) · the tile, the red glow, the second odometer (phrase 4)
beats.caption: A tile pops up by his desk. Far down it glows red; a $ odometer spins faster. The racks go red-hot.
cues: music: MM-16 settles to a bass pedal under the heat shimmer
palette: the racks step green → amber → red, one a bar

beats.frame: MCU·PF · Mas looking down the hole
beats.caption: Something moves on his face for the first time: one tear. Rima reads it as sentiment; he corrects her.

lines.text: A million people, Mas. That's for them, isn't it?

beats.frame: HIGH · the tear falls to the GPU
beats.caption: The tear lands on a red-hot GPU. Tssss. At the edge, his phone lights red; a siren's whine.
cues: sfx: tssss, steam in three held puffs · the phone's siren J-cuts in under the last puff
beats.real: lock option, not used by default: Mas, "…the compute costs are eye-watering" [K† · DEC 5, 2022]

beats.frame: INSERT · his phone on the desk (1 bar)
beats.caption: A red news alert with a siren glyph. His thumb opens it; the app zooms to full-bleed.
cues: music: MM-16 climbs back to intensity 2, in the siren's colour
beats.real: DEC 21, 2022 · the rival's alarm · the founders' summons was reported JAN 20, 2023 (facts #5), so no date on it

beats.frame: POV · his phone, full-bleed: Elgoog's lobby
beats.caption: A floor slab slides aside; a siren the size of a water tower rises on a scissor lift and turns.
cues: sound: the phone's own audio inside the bullpen bed (every sc 8 line on the small-speaker chain)

beats.frame: POV · Radnus beside the hole
beats.caption: Serene, with a small extinguisher, very slightly on fire. He pats it out; it relights.

lines.text: Everyone, it's fine. Let's take this offline.

onscreen.text: RADNUS · RUNS ELGOOG · POLITELY ON FIRE

beats.frame: POV · the crypt steps, the siren, Radnus (held through the exchange)
beats.caption: Two founders climb out of a crypt, shading their eyes. Is search all right? Someone else built that?

lines.text: We heard the siren. Is it search? Is search all right?
Search is fine. It's a chat thing. People like talking to it.
Someone else built that? It looks like our work.
It is ours. We published it.

beats.real: "It is ours. We published it.": the transformer paper [K], no date claim

beats.frame: POV · the lanyards
beats.caption: Radnus hands them two lanyards: GUEST. The siren turns; his sleeve relights.

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas: the phone in his hand (1 bar)
beats.caption: He locks it; the red goes out of the frame. He stands and walks out of frame right.
cues: music: MM-16 rings out on the lock · sfx: the NopeAI revolving door's rubber sweep pre-laps

beats.frame: WIDE · the NopeAI lobby
beats.caption: Mas walks in from frame left with his glass, continuing his exit, and crosses to the desk.
cues: sound: the lobby bed (the revolving door's rubber sweep, a reception phone, steps on stone)

beats.frame: WIDE (cont.) · the delivery
beats.caption: A novelty check jams in the revolving door, right under the gold letters: it won't fit through.
cues: music: LEVERAGE (MM-08 stems) from the check's arrival: pizzicato + muted 808 on the door's squeak

beats.frame: INSERT · the check
beats.caption: The check, in 7 px. The asterisk is too small to read.
beats.real: JAN 23, 2023 · MACROSOFT: "multiyear, multibillion dollar" [V] · ~$10B (reported) on the rail

beats.frame: WIDE · FULL FREEZE: the landlord's card
beats.caption: Tasya was already in the lobby, like part of the wall. Mas keeps moving in the freeze, to the check.

onscreen.text: TASYA / THE LANDLORD · MACROSOFT · KEYS: ONE PER TENANT

cues: style: 2-TONE full freeze (Tasya's card; one of the two full freezes)

beats.frame: INSERT · the pen into his pocket (still frozen)
beats.caption: He pockets the pen clipped to the check. (Business 1 of 2.)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Tasya, the jammed door between
beats.caption: The freeze lifts. "It's a partnership." Gerg tugs the check by a corner. "It's stuck." "It's long-term."

lines.text: Mas, we're very pleased. It's a partnership.

beats.frame: WIDE · the check slides under the door
beats.caption: Tasya slides it under the door. It fits exactly, like a floor. After you. Mas steps on at once.

beats.frame: MCU · Mas: the third collar
beats.caption: Pop. A third collar surfaces at his neck (collar #3).
cues: sfx: pop · music: the LEVERAGE ostinato stops on the pop (one of the act's few stops)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the terms (held: his one talk with the landlord)
beats.caption: "Suits you." He holds a beat, then asks the price. A welcome that is really a lease. Rent is due.

lines.text: Oh, we don't think of it as rent. Everything you build, you'll build on our servers, as many as you like, for as long as you like. We'll keep the lights on and the floors warm. You keep doing whatever it is you do upstairs at night.
Everyone is welcome. Rent is due on the first.

cues: sound: the lobby bed only under the terms, no music (OST owner: confirm by ear, or a low pad)
music: LEVERAGE comes back on the key ring's offbeat jangle, a new phrase

beats.frame: WIDE · weeks on (the time jump, then held)
beats.caption: The check on the floor, scuffed grey. One more key on his ring. On the TV, GNIB: a search box that chats.

lines.text: That's our model in there. You're going after Elgoog with it?
"…I want people to know that we made them dance…"

beats.real: FEB 7, 2023 · GNIB launches · TASYA to The Verge: "…we made them dance…" [V]

beats.frame: SCR · the lobby TV: Radnus tap-dances
beats.caption: Across town, on the TV: Radnus tap-dances, two drawings, extinguisher held politely aside.

beats.frame: SCR · the TV: the telescope, the ticker
beats.caption: A giant telescope turns until its lens stares straight at him. The ticker, then the figure.

onscreen.text: TICKER: DRAB DEMO GETS A TELESCOPE FACT WRONG

cues: style: LEDGER flash-print, 6 frames, on the figure; then it holds in the ticker to read
beats.real: FEB 8, 2023 · the demo's telescope error · ≈ −$100B, ≈7.7% in one day [V]

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Gerg looks from the TV to Mas
beats.caption: Mas sips. "ours does that too." Gerg looks down at his own laptop and, quietly, closes it.
cues: the scene's button is Gerg's: he closes his laptop, quietly

beats.frame: WIDE · a chat bubble drifts in
beats.caption: A pastel chat bubble floats in behind Tasya like a dog that followed him home, and drifts too close.
cues: music: LEVERAGE runs on

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Sydney, a pixel too close (held)
beats.caption: Her date stamp is a year behind. He mentions it; she scolds him sweetly. He compliments her.

lines.text: "You have not been a good user. I have been a good chatbot. I have been right, clear, and polite. I have been a good GNIB. 😊"
you've been an extremely good gnib.

beats.real: ~FEB 13, 2023 · SYDNEY: "You have not been a good user…" [V] (all four sentences, source order)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Tasya and Sydney: the egg timer
beats.caption: Without breaking his smile, Tasya clips a small egg timer to her chain. It reads 5. House rules.

lines.text: Keep it short, Sydney. House rules.

beats.frame: WIDE · she floats back out the door
beats.caption: She floats out, looking over her shoulder, ticking in tempo.
cues: sfx: Sydney's egg timer ticks in LEVERAGE's tempo; LEVERAGE falls away under it

beats.frame: WIDE · the bullpen from the aisle (pre-beat)
beats.caption: Mas at his end desk looks up at the wall monitor over the whiteboard.
cues: sound: Sydney's tick carries the pre-beat over the bullpen bed (2 bars, never silent)

beats.frame: INSERT · the wall monitor: an imageboard (his look motivates it)
beats.caption: A crate stencilled ATEM tips; its weights spill over the thread. Kram unveils a wet OPEN SOURCE hoodie.

onscreen.text: KRAM · RUNS ATEM · PAINT STILL WET

beats.real: MAR 3, 2023 · ATEM model weights leak on an imageboard [V] · the model stays unnamed

beats.caption: Left: a GTP-4 demo, Gerg photographing a napkin sketch. Right: Mario dictates a memo to Clod.

lines.text: Memo, on race dynamics. Point one: we must not launch on the same day as them. That's how a race starts.

cues: music: MM-04 Lighthouse, 16 bars: Gerg's Build (chip, left) against the Addendum (string quartet, right)

cues: music: MM-04 thins to the quartet's held chord under Mas's post

beats.caption: Nole signs with his left hand and solders a GPU with his right. Oigneb holds up PAUSE. Nobody pauses.

onscreen.text: NOLE · EARLY FUNDER · BUILDING HIS OWN
